Native Windows Job Object containment lives in visible_ceremony_supervisor: it creates the job with ONLY JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE (0x2000) via the FrlsVisible.JobApi P/Invoke surface, starts the entry CREATE_SUSPENDED, AssignProcessToJobObject, then ResumeThread. BREAKAWAY flags are never set; assign failure kills the suspended child without resuming.

SecureString credential ceremony lives in operator_ceremony and operator_apply_ceremony: Read-Host -AsSecureString, SecureStringToBSTR/PtrToStringBSTR, ZeroFreeBSTR, process-env handoff only, cleared on every outcome. The URL never reaches argv, chat, logs, or emitted evidence.

System32 PowerShell resolution (absolute %SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe, reparse-point and PATH-shim rejected) is enforced in supervisor, visible entry, visible launcher, and both operator ceremonies before any child process starts.

Visible ceremony: run visible_ceremony_supervisor with -CeremonyKind dry-run|apply; it materializes visible_ceremony_entry from tip under the Job Object. CeremonyKind dry-run selects operator_ceremony; apply selects operator_apply_ceremony. Missing/unknown kind fails before PROMPT_READY.
Enter materializes launcher + the seal-selected ceremony from freeze blobs only; never execute mutable worktree scripts as authority.

FRLS has no fixture Target #2 world: the ceremonies forward only the sealed apply token, and FRLS_CEREMONY_ALLOW_SYNTHETIC_URL is the single harness channel (loopback 127.0.0.1 only, never on the interactive SecureString path).
CONTAINMENT_APPLY_DATABASE_URL is not an FRLS channel; both operator ceremonies fail closed with BLOCKED_RETIRED_CREDENTIAL_CHANNEL if it is set, and the visible chain clears it.

required_prior_dry_run_evidence_sha256 / required_prior_dry_run_freeze / required_prior_dry_run_evidence_tip are null until the first authorized production dry-run publishes them. While they are null the apply ceremony, visible entry, and supervisor all refuse apply with BLOCKED_PRIOR_DRY_RUN_PINS_UNPUBLISHED; -PriorDryRunEvidencePath is therefore optional at the shell boundary and enforced against the sealed authorization once the pins exist.
